id.help: Unique id; a map side names it in faction.

description.help: Text shown when the person picks a faction.

units.help: Unit types the faction may build (leave out for all).

structures.help: Structures it may use (leave out for all).

techs.help: Technologies it may research (leave out for all).

start.help: What the side starts with, on top of the map's own.

resources.help: Resources added at the start (0 or more).

modifiers.help: Side-wide skills as plain ids or { skill, filter } entries.

commanders.help: Commanders a side of this faction may pick (needs commanders.json; not empty).

weights.help: One weight set of rules.ai.weights; unwritten keys keep the default.
